operation_details.item: The user always leads negotiations with the lowest possible discount and ignores value-based pricing, packaging, or multi-year terms.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! How’s the client pipeline looking today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty active. I’m preparing for a few renewal and expansion conversations with key accounts.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Are you shaping the proposals around business outcomes, or keeping the discussions focused mainly on price?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I usually lead with the lowest possible discount. I don’t spend much time on value-based pricing, packaging options, or multi-year terms.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That keeps the offer straightforward. How are you planning to coach the team on handling pushback in those negotiations?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I’ll have them stay disciplined, protect the relationship, and avoid giving away more than necessary while moving deals forward.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that When negotiating deals, I always lead with the lowest possible discount and ignore value-based pricing, packaging, or multi-year terms.
